For other filings, there's also a notification method available:

![image|690x330](upload://9aOCibiQjhhiTttgqpGoezyyko3.png)

**achiu** (7/9/2025):

Hi Patty,

In general all communication is done via email in the new system so there are no options to select notification method.

There are processes(very rare) that result physical mail but that is not something an api user has control over.
